data.counts_contract: Magnitude M_phys-5log10(h), disjoint survivors, calibration-only independent 20% parent mark sample; old heldout hash preserved, training fraction now .6. Totals bound in corrected_counts.json, not inherited historical totals. No observed-total centring.
data.limitations: Survival mark model conditions on population/radius and assumes ignorable residual environment/sky dependence. Uncertain survival marginalized; field model, LF and imported parent bias/density priors still approximate. Real-data diagnostic, not calibrated science.

selection_correction.conditional_survival_prior: 36 Beta(1,1) probabilities, updated by calibration-only parent survival marks, then jointly sampled with fields; no holdout or density-fit count used for calibration
selection_correction.fixed_partition: same recno hash: [0,.2) heldout; [.2,.4) selection calibration; [.4,1) field training
selection_correction.CF4_crossmatch_exclusion: unchanged; no reintroduction of same-object velocity/count measurements
selection_correction.metadata_exclusion: retain frozen exclusions; apply the same <=.05 map-mark discrepancy and positive map support to new magnitude-admitted rows
